title: stellaria graminea var. latifolia
intro: Stellaria graminea var. latifolia, commonly known as broad-leafed chickweed, is a plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of broad-leafed chickweed include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-edematous effects, and exert a sedative influence on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
